facts: Declared env variables are the contract between a publisher and every consumer of the package, so the surface must be right. [L6]
Use path for directory lists such as PATH and MANPATH, and constant for prefix variables and version markers. [L12]
Option-list variables fit neither shape, since path prepends with a separator and constant replaces the whole value. [L16]
A list entry appends its contribution with the author's separator and removes an earlier duplicate of it first. [L18]
The separator is required in package metadata, because no human is present to be told what was assumed. [L30]
JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS, NODE_OPTIONS and GODEBUG take the last occurrence as the override. [L38]
RUST_LOG resolves to the most specific target, so a broader directive appended later does not silence a narrower one. [L39]
Content-addressed storage puts a package at a different path on each machine, so values use interpolation tokens, not hardcoded paths. [L50]
Four token bodies are recognized, and the install-path bodies accept an optional native or posix render modifier. [L52]
The deps token resolves to a declared dependency's content directory, named by its last path segment or explicit name. [L56]
A wrapper uses its cmake dependency's installPath to keep the path to its helper stable across registry layouts. [L58]
The JSON example publishes MYTOOL_HELPER as a public constant pointing at the cmake dependency's cmake-gen binary. [L63]
A resolved value is capped at 64 KiB, and a chain exceeding it is refused with exit 65 at composition time. [L73]
Each env entry's visibility field selects one or both of two surfaces, interface for consumers and private for launchers. [L78]
private is the default, reaching only the package's own launchers and not consumers. [L87]
public reaches both surfaces, which suits variables like PATH and JAVA_HOME. [L88]
interface reaches consumers only, for values such as PKG_CONFIG_PATH that the package itself does not use. [L89]
The sealed value is rejected on env entries, since an entry reaching neither surface is dead configuration. [L91]
For constants the last declaration wins silently in exec and env, replacing the earlier one in the main path. [L99]
Entry visibility arrived with the entry-points release, and before that every variable was implicitly public. [L105]
Migration is a one-time annotation pass on metadata.json, and variables added later default to private. [L107]
Variables without a visibility field now default to private, so consumers need explicit public annotations. [L141]
PATH pointing at the bin directory should be public, since consumers need it on their PATH. [L147]
With entrypoints declared, OCX prepends the entrypoints directory to PATH, so bin can become private. [L153]
